basics.name: Nadia Regli
basics.label: Mechatronics Engineer
basics.summary: A Mechatronics Engineer with a Bachelor of Engineering (Hons) from the University of Queensland and two years of professional experience in software development and robotics. My background combines strong programming skills, a solid foundation in robotics, electronics and systems integration, and experience with project management and collaboration in team-based engineering environments. I am seeking an engineering role where I can apply both hardware and software knowledge to develop automation, robotics or embedded systems.

work.name: Ernst & Young
work.summary:
Enterprise CMS Platform - Leading Australian Health Insurance Provider
Vue.js, C#, Kentico CMS, Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD B2C, Jira, Confluence.
highlights: Developed and delivered full-stack features across the public website, member portal and consultant portal for a major Australian health insurance provider.
Investigated and resolved application defects across front-end and back-end systems, improving platform stability and user experience.
Diagnosed and resolved issues in Azure Function Apps and backend APIs, ensuring reliable integration across distributed cloud services.
Implemented multi-factor authentication within the website sign-in flow using Azure AD B2C, improving platform security.
Delivered a Kentico CMS platform migration to a newer version to maintain platform support and long-term maintainability.
Tested and deployed API updates across development environments using Azure DevOps pipelines.
Conducted code reviews and testing improvements to maintain high-quality, maintainable code across the development team.
Produced technical documentation to support maintainability, onboarding and knowledge sharing within the engineering team.
Presented and demonstrated technical solutions to senior stakeholders and C-suite client representatives, translating technical implementations into clear business outcomes.
Mentored new team members and coordinated with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated platform improvements.
Organised team engagement initiatives that strengthened collaboration and team culture.

work.name: Universal Field Robots
work.summary:
Autonomous Mining Robots
ROS, ROS2, Python, C++, Gazebo, RViz, Linux, Git.
highlights: Developed robotics software in Python and C++ with a Linux (Ubuntu) environment using ROS architecture.
Developed a navigation path planning and parking algorithm for autonomous robot positioning and docking.
Designed interfaces and signal filtering for wheel weight sensors to detect load distribution and improve sensor data reliability.
Migrated robotics software from ROS to ROS2, improving system modularity and compatibility with modern robotics frameworks.
Visualised and tested robot behaviour using RViz and Gazebo simulation environments to validate navigation and system performance.
Processed and analysed sensor data to diagnose system behaviour and support robotics problem solving.
Collaborated with robotics engineers in team meetings and technical discussions to develop solutions for underground and open-cut mining robotics applications.

work.name: The University of Queensland
work.summary:
Tutor for 2nd-4th year mechatronics engineering courses
Control systems, Mechatronics design, Engineering education.
highlights: Delivered tutorials and practical sessions for 2nd-4th year mechatronics engineering courses, including Control Systems Implementation, Control Engineering and Mechatronic System Design Project I and II.
Presented lessons and worked through engineering problem solutions for tutorial groups of 100+ students, explaining complex control system concepts clearly and effectively.
Guided students through control system concepts including feedback control, Laplace transforms, root locus and frequency response analysis.
Mentored students in mechatronic design projects, assisting with system design, prototyping, testing and troubleshooting.
Provided one-on-one technical support to help students solve engineering problems and understand complex course material.
Assisted students in designing, building and evaluating mechatronic systems for final-year design projects.
Marked assignments, reports and project submissions while providing constructive technical feedback.
Facilitated discussions and workshops that encouraged problem solving, engineering thinking and collaborative project development.

work.name: Santos

Review of Oil Reservoir Modelling Techniques
Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Petrel, Eclipse, Data analysis, Document review, Presentation skills.
highlights: Reviewed documentation and modelling techniques used in oil reservoir simulations to identify opportunities to improve workflow consistency and modelling reliability.
Analysed existing engineering workflows and proposed process improvements to standardise modelling practices, improving predictability and efficiency of reservoir simulations.
Conducted technical research and evaluated modelling methodologies used across subsurface engineering teams.
Produced a technical report outlining recommended workflow improvements and standardisation strategies.
Presented findings and recommendations to engineering teams in a company-wide presentation, communicating technical insights and process improvements.

Fostered rodents in need of temporary care, providing a safe and nurturing environment to support their rehabilitation and rehoming efforts.
Coordinated with the transport of rodents to veterinary appointments, ensuring they received necessary medical care and support for their health and wellbeing.
